return moire.control.action('culture')
return moire.control.action('wash')
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 200); return 1
return moire.control.action('genomes')

const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding, electrons: S.electrons }
